name: Google Business Profile
description: Suspension recovery and local pack visibility. Cost-of-suspension calculator, service radius map, diagnosis from a real profile audit.

sections.title: What every week is costing you
The area you should be showing in

fields.label: Profile status
fields.help: Switches the framing of the whole page. 'Suspended' is the urgent version.

fields.label: Headline
fields.aiHint: One blunt sentence naming the situation in the client's own terms. For a suspension: state that they are absent from Maps, not that they rank poorly. Name their trade and city. Under 110 characters.

fields.label: Opening paragraph
fields.aiHint: Three sentences. What a suspension actually removes, why it matters more for an emergency trade than a considered purchase, and one honest note on what still works in their favour. Do not use the words 'unlock', 'leverage' or 'journey'.

fields.label: What the suspension removes
fields.aiHint: Between four and six items, each under 100 characters, each naming one concrete thing the client has lost: local pack position, review visibility, direction requests, click-to-call, and so on. Written as losses, not features.

fields.label: Enquiries a week from Google
fields.help: Seeds the cost calculator on the page. The reader can change it themselves.

fields.label: What we found
fields.aiHint: Three to six findings drawn ONLY from the audit facts and agent brief. Never invent one. `issue` is a short noun phrase under 60 chars. `evidence` quotes the specific thing found — a conflicting service area, a missing street address, a mismatched phone number. `fix` is one sentence on what will be done about it. If fewer than three real findings exist, return fewer.

fields.label: What already works for them
fields.aiHint: Two to five genuine assets found in the audit — a live website, service pages, a photo gallery, trade licences, existing reviews. Each under 90 characters. This section exists so the proposal is not purely negative; only list things actually observed.

fields.label: Business location
fields.help: Optional. Left blank, the map centres itself on the average of the locations below — which is usually what you wanted anyway.

fields.label: Coverage options
fields.help: Each option draws a ring on the map and ties to a pricing tier.

fields.label: The recovery plan
fields.aiHint: Two or three phases. Phase one is always reinstatement; later phases are ranking expansion. `title` under 40 chars, `window` a plain timeframe, `focus` one sentence, `steps` three to six concrete numbered actions grounded in the findings above.

fields.label: What we do and don't guarantee
fields.help: Fixed wording. Never model-written — this is the paragraph that protects you if reinstatement is refused.
default: We guarantee the reinstatement request is prepared correctly, submitted, and appealed as many times as Google permits.
We cannot guarantee Google reinstates a profile. That decision is theirs alone and no agency can commit to it.
If the profile is not reinstated within the term, the ranking work on your website continues at no additional cost.
